description: This file contains the implementation for Honda 600 engine configuration, including setting fuel and ignition tables, mapping hardware pins, and engine-specific parameters for a microcontroller-based engine control unit (ECU). It defines engine setup functions and configuration details specific to Honda 600 models.

methods.name: setDefaultCustomMaps
methods.description: Initializes fuel load, RPM, timing load, and RPM bins and copies default fuel and timing tables into engine configuration.

methods.name: setHonda600
methods.description: Configures engine parameters specific to Honda 600, including trigger type, fuel algorithm, wiring setup, sensor channels, output pins, and miscellaneous engine settings.
